author: Unity
description:
Discover Unity Neural and the Unity Graphics Kernel (UGK)—two major advancements designed to accelerate compute performance, slash memory usage, and modernize rendering across the engine.

Learn how Neural Texture Compression (NTC) integrates natively into the Unity Editor, enabling you to train models on your own data using Unity Sentis to compress textures beyond traditional formats at near-lossless quality. In benchmarks with the Atrio sample scene, NTC reduced texture VRAM by nearly 30% and cut total disk size by 30% without sacrificing visual fidelity. Working with industry partners to leverage Shader Model 6.10 hardware acceleration, Unity Neural delivers high-speed inference directly within the Universal Render Pipeline (URP).

title: Unity Texture Compression (NTC) and Unity Graphics Kernel (UGK)
